newsitem.title: CANADA: Bema drilling confirms more gold in Chile.
newsitem.headline: Bema drilling confirms more gold in Chile.

text.p: Bema Gold Corp and Arizona Star Resource Corp said late Thursday that new drill results from its Cerro Roman discovery area in Chile continue to confirm the presence of a large porphyry gold system.
The results suggest Cerro Roman, on the Aldebaran property, has the potential to host a multi-million ounce gold deposit, the companies said in a statement.
Two additional drill holes two kilometres northeast of Cerro Roman at the Jotabeche zone indicate another gold bearing porphyry discovery, Bema and Arizona Star said.
The discovery, along with Cerro Roman and Romancito, could be part of one larger mineralized body, they said.
Bema Gold is the largest shareholder of Arizona Star and manages its affairs.

Shares in the Vancouver-based mining exploration company shot up to C$8.10 on Thursday from C$7.20 on Wednesday after Bema released drill results expanding the size of its Cerro Casale copper-gold deposit, also on the Aldebaran property in Chile.
